title: Ward Mission Leader Process
body: The weekly missionary coordination meeting, step by step. Each week, ward leaders and missionaries counsel together to help each person take the next step on the covenant path. Huddle keeps that plan in one place, on your phone.

title: Four steps, in order
body:
1. Before ward council
2. Ward council
3. The Huddle
4. After the huddle
Up next shows where you are. A finished step gets a green check.

title: Open the Covenant Path Report
body: Before ward council, open the report in Member Tools and bring each name up to date.

title: Tap each name
body: Update the next ordinance, needs, temple attendance and sacrament attendance. Add anyone new; remove anyone no longer on the report.

title: Everything about one person
body: Each person has a screen of their own. Done brings you back to the list.

title: Mark it done
body: When the names match the report, tap All up to date · Mark done.

title: Who and what
body: Step 1 has its green check. Ward council is up next.

title: Counsel together
body: Ward council decides who to focus on, each person’s next ordinance, and what they need.

title: The Covenant Path Report
body: New members, returning members, and those being taught, each in its own color.

title: Next ordinance and needs
body: Enter them once. They show up in the Huddle, so nothing is typed twice.

title: Up to three focus names
body: Ward council chooses them. Give each one a next ordinance and what they need to get there.

title: Never add confidential information
body: Everyone who receives the huddle report can read it. Keep it to names, ordinances and simple needs.

title: How and when
body: The Huddle is the weekly coordination meeting: brief, focused, and about people.

title: Five sections
body: The bar shows how many are done. Work through them in any order.

title: Who came
body: In Huddle Attendees, tap everyone who attended. Make an extra effort to involve the youth.

title: Did it happen?
body: Last week’s assignments come back here. Tap Yes, Partly or No, and add a short note on how it went.

title: One person at a time
body: Tap each name to plan how the ward will help this week.

title: Questions to guide you
body: Tap How can we help? for the questions in Preach My Gospel, chapter 13, for that group.

title: Sacrament attendance
body: Check it if they were at sacrament meeting.

title: One action item
body: What will we do this week to help them prepare for their next ordinance? Who will do it, and when?

title: The 30-day temple goal
body: Every new member attends the temple for baptisms for the dead within 30 days of baptism. The box counts down until it’s checked.

title: Text this assignment
body: Send each assignment by text, so the person asked to help knows exactly what, for whom, and when.

title: A plan for every name
body: Each name now shows its action item, who, and when.

kicker: Step 3 · Find New People to Teach
title: Love, share, invite
body: Write the ward’s plan for the week and who will do what. How can we help? and the tips are there for ideas.

title: All five sections done
body: Mark each section done as you go. The bar fills in.

title: Up next: After the huddle
body: Three green checks. One step left before you send.

title: Update the Covenant Path Report
body: This page lists what happened for each person. Update the report in Member Tools to match.

title: Mark it done
body: Tap It’s all updated · Mark done. Then you can send.

title: All four steps done
body: Send turns solid blue. Tap it.

title: Share the huddle report
body: Send it to the bishop-approved list, the stake presidency and the full-time missionaries, and include yourself. Only share via email or text message. Do not share through any other app.

title: Sent
body: This week’s assignments move to Return and Report for next time. Names and needs stay for ward council.

title: Follow up
body: As people report back, mark each assignment Yes, Partly or No. Offer help where it’s needed.

title: One by one
body: Helping each person take the next step on the covenant path, together as a ward.
fine: Never add confidential information to this agenda.
